description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader committed to delivering exceptional patient care and operational excellence.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Your leadership will be crucial in maintaining high standards of quality care, financial stability, and community engagement.This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, commensurate with experience. If you are a proven leader ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated ability to manage facility operations, financial performance, and regulatory compliance.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $115,000 - $145,000 per year, based on experience.
